name: Gekko
biography: Los Angeles native Gekko leads a tight-knit crew of tumultuous critters.

abilities.name: Dizzy
abilities.description: Send Dizzy forward to unleash plasma blasts at enemies in line of sight.
abilities.tacticalNotes: Flashes enemies; can be picked up after cooldown to reuse.

abilities.name: Wingman
abilities.description: Send Wingman forward to seek out enemies or plant/defuse the Spike.
abilities.tacticalNotes: Can interact with the Spike and concusses the first enemy he sees.

abilities.name: Mosh Pit
abilities.description: Throw Mosh like a grenade upon landing he duplicates across a large area.
abilities.tacticalNotes: Explodes after a short delay, dealing massive damage in an area.

abilities.name: Thrash
abilities.description: Link with Thrash's mind to steer her through enemy territory.
abilities.tacticalNotes: Detonate to detain enemies in a radius; can be picked up and reused once.

name: Chamber
biography: Well-dressed and deadly, French weapons designer Chamber keeps lanes locked down with custom firepower.

abilities.name: Trademark
abilities.description: Place a trap that scans for enemies. When a visible enemy comes in range, the trap counts down and destabilizes the terrain.
abilities.tacticalNotes: Creates a lingering slow field when triggered.

abilities.name: Headhunter
abilities.description: Activate to equip a heavy pistol. Alt-fire aims down sights.
abilities.tacticalNotes: High precision, kills in one headshot at any range.

abilities.name: Rendezvous
abilities.description: Place two teleport anchors. While on the ground and in range, reactivate to teleport to the other anchor.
abilities.tacticalNotes: Anchors can be picked up and redeployed to create aggressive angles.

abilities.name: Tour De Force
abilities.description: Summon a custom, incredibly powerful sniper rifle that kills enemies with any direct hit.
abilities.tacticalNotes: Leaves behind a lingering slow field on kill.
